title: Spicy Paella with Collard Greens
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this spicy paella combines the flavors of Japan with the nutrition of collard greens.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy Japanese sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the saffron rice and stir to coat with the oil and mix with the sausage and spices.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
Stir in the collard greens and cook until wilted.
Season with soy sauce, lime juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
